name: Hirki Plus Patch (H.P.P.)
description:
A modular gameplay and balance patch for Heroes of Might and Magic III on VCMI, designed for use with **Horn of the Abyss**.

H.P.P. improves selected underused systems while preserving the classic feel of Heroes III. Its modules can be enabled separately, so players can choose the parts they want.
author: bew_

polish.name: Hirki Plus Patch (H.P.P.)
polish.description:
Modularna poprawka rozgrywki i balansu dla Heroes of Might and Magic III na VCMI, przeznaczona do gry z **Horn of the Abyss**.

H.P.P. rozwija wybrane, rzadziej używane elementy gry, zachowując klasyczny charakter Heroes III. Moduły można włączać osobno, dzięki czemu gracz może wybrać tylko te części, których chce używać.

1.3.0: Reworked Golden Goose with stacking per-Estates-hero income bonuses and updated component artifact classes.
Reworked Cornucopia with stacking per-specialist rare-resource bonuses.
Added Acid Burst, a level 4 Water Magic spell with progressive enemy stat reduction.
Added starting-army modules for standard tier 3–6 creature specialists.
Added Boots of Reinforcement — a new Relic combination artifact.
1.2.1: Fixed Polish Slayer spell and Coronius specialty text appearing in the English version of the game.
1.2.0: Added Towns category with Elemental Ritual, Resource Specialist Silos and Gold Specialist Halls modules.
Added Magic Mirror Luck scaling to Luck Spells.
Updated New Ranged: increased Advanced and Expert Archery maximum ammo bonuses.
Added Artifacts category with Diplomatic Artifacts module.
Updated selected Polish Launcher mastery wording.
1.1.2: Added initial Czech translation - all in game text is done, no Launcher related texts for now
Moved Polish translation files to proper structure
1.1.1: Fixed Polish localization keys for selected HPP runtime IDs.
Added missing Polish fallback text for Trailblazer.
1.1.0: Added and updated selected map object reward modules.
